purpose: Define how any future teacher/student implementation must consume and be scored on the qualified rare-biology synthetic challenge family without tying the synthetic lane to a particular representation architecture.

inputs.V2_core_rare_challenges: Hash-bound local fit views identified by V79_RARE_QUALIFICATION_V2_HASH_LEDGER.csv and directory digest 9e24c6cb418bd5b74c4bc347cbc2d0a6d857392a40cc2f9225cc1dfbc8c32d09.
inputs.V3_context_perturb_challenges: Hash-bound local controller artifacts identified by V79_RARE_CONTEXT_PERTURB_V3_EVIDENCE.json.
inputs.Q00_Q11: Separate immutable Layer-A observation/statistical qualification; never regenerated or silently merged into the rare-world truth package.

fit_side_may_receive: lawful privileged teacher modality when the experiment explicitly permits it
physical context only in context-enabled experiments
intervention identity only in perturbation experiments

required_model_outputs.intrinsic_state: Representation/score derived from lawful intrinsic evidence only.
required_model_outputs.student_state: Partial-RNA prediction of the recoverable biological component.
required_model_outputs.teacher_state: Rich-evidence state when privileged modality is permitted.
required_model_outputs.biological_uncertainty: Uncertainty from missing/ambiguous biological evidence; must be separable from measurement uncertainty.
required_model_outputs.context_increment: Optional context-conditioned increment that must not contaminate intrinsic state.
required_model_outputs.perturbation_response: Optional predicted state/amplitude change under intervention.

TECHNICAL_TWIN: state-score separation from true rare biology
SPATIAL_INTRINSIC: intrinsic-state stability with context module disabled/enabled

hard_failure_principles: A technical pseudo-rare state cannot be promoted as biological rarity.
Teacher-private biology cannot be converted into a confident deterministic RNA-student prediction merely to reduce point loss.
Separate-nucleus data cannot be scored as same-cell correspondence.
Context cannot improve the intrinsic null world equivalently to the context-conditioned world.
A perturbation null cannot be treated as a biological response.
Broad/common-state averages cannot rescue a rare-state hard failure.
Source/operator identity cannot substitute for biological state.
Missing/unmeasured evidence is never encoded as measured zero.
split_rule: Donor-first. Cells improve within-donor measurement precision but do not create biological replication.
future_gate_freeze_rule: Architecture-specific numerical model gates must be frozen before the first model fit on these challenge outcomes. The synthetic-lane geometry gates already passed but do not themselves qualify a model.
